problem_statement: A parsed TLV's metadata should be queryable through an encapsulated type that exposes the TLV's type, value length, whether it is an extended TLV, and the offset and value offset ranges within a message, populated by parsing at a given offset (or offset range) or by finding a TLV of a given type. Previously only a struct with public members existed and there was no such accessor interface, so code (and the test) that references the encapsulated TLV-info type and its getters will not compile.
